name: The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho
insider_take: Perched 30 floors above Tokyo's imperial district, this architectural marvel transforms the skyline into your personal canvas.
whats_special: The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho occupies floors 30-36 of the Kioi Tower, making it one of Tokyo's highest luxury hotels. Located in the prestigious Kioicho district, it sits mere steps from the Imperial Palace and offers unobstructed views of Tokyo's iconic landmarks including Mount Fuji on clear days. The hotel features Japan's largest hotel spa and houses contemporary art installations throughout its sky-high galleries.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing west for stunning sunset views over the Imperial Palace gardens, and visit the 36th-floor Levita lounge during golden hour for the most Instagram-worthy Tokyo skyline shots.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service with panoramic city views, a treatment at the cloud-level spa with floor-to-ceiling windows, and exploring the nearby Hie Shrine with its famous red torii tunnel staircase - a hidden gem just a 5-minute walk away that locals consider one of Tokyo's most photogenic spots.
pros: Premium location in prestigious Kioicho district with easy access to Imperial Palace
Stunning panoramic city views from upper floors of 36-story tower
Exceptional Japanese hospitality with refined luxury amenities
Part of prestigious Marriott STARS program with exclusive benefits
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury positioning
High-rise urban setting may not suit guests preferring traditional ryokan experience
